sloka: गते हि मयि तत्रेयं राजपुत्री यशस्विनी ।परित्राणमविन्दन्ती जानकी जीवितं त्यजेत् ।। ५.३०.९।।।।
transliteration: gate hi mayi tatreyaṁ rājaputrī yaśasvinī ।paritrāṇamavindantī jānakī jīvitaṁ tyajet ।। 5.30.9।।।।

translations.english: "If I so back, this illustrious princess, Janaki will give up her life, finding no means of deliverance (from this tragic situation).
